Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, I wanted to start the renewal-origination thread so we can surface the timeline, a few term options, and an initial QBR window. High level ask: can you confirm Novamed’s preferred renewal target date (we currently have 2028-10-01 in HubSpot) and whether procurement or legal will lead the contract redlines?

Proposed next steps:
- Align on target renewal date and any term-length preferences (12/24/36 months) — Novamed
- Share Redwood term options and suggested uplift pricing for +20% capacity — Redwood (attached)
- Book an internal QBR calendar window (we'll send 2 options) — joint
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to record milestones (attached stub) and DocuSign plan — joint

For transparency: I attached a short Term_Options_Summary (PDF) and a blank Mutual_Action_Plan (XLSX) to this thread. I’ve CC’d David for legal/SLAs and Vanessa for the account staffing/runbook.

Availability: I can lock a 60-minute slot for a QBR on either Aug 8 (10–11am PT) or Aug 10 (1–2pm PT). If those don't work, suggest two slots and we'll accommodate.

Appreciate a quick confirm so we can get procurement looped in and start the MAP.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal origination: term options, staffing cadence, and QBR scheduling

Hi Monica —

Appreciate the note and the attachments. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Target renewal date: Oct 1, 2028 is fine, but we are open to earlier execution if pricing and SLAs are finalized by mid-Sept.
- Term preference: Our Finance team prefers 24 months, but we will evaluate 12 vs 24 depending on anchor pricing.
- Procurement will own the commercial redlines; legal will join for any SLA specifics. 

QBR windows: Aug 8 (10–11am PT) conflicts with our all-hands. Aug 10 (1–2pm PT) looks good — tentatively accept. If anything changes I'll loop in procurement@novamed to confirm.

A couple of asks before the QBR:
1) Can you add a one-page summary of the proposed +20% capacity uplift with projected token spend impact?
2) We need a list of audit evidence items for our Security/Compliance team (SOC2 scope, retention, encryption at rest).

Thanks — can we also get the MAP pre-populated with the first three milestones so we can attach it to our renewal packet?

Best,
Emma Thompson
Director, Strategic Procurement | Novamed
emma.thompson@novamed.com

Following up on Emma’s asks. I attached a short evidence checklist for procurement and security (SOC2 artifacts, data retention summary, KMS integrations). Also included a one-page uplift economics sheet that maps +20% capacity to per-token delta and estimated monthly spend (spreadsheet attached).

Two legal notes to flag before the QBR:
- If Novamed prefers a 24-month term, we typically offer a 6% discount vs our 12-month list; for 36-month we can layer in an additional 4% and commit to a stepped capacity schedule.
- SLA: standard enterprise SLA covers uptime and priority support; if you need tighter SLOs we can include an SLA appendix but will need to confirm staffing and credits (we can discuss in QBR).

I've pre-filled the MAP with the first three milestones: 1) Confirm renewal date & term selection (08/15 target), 2) Finalize pricing and uplift economics (09/05), 3) Execute DocuSign (09/20). Please review and add any internal checkpoints Novamed requires.
